notes.title: Merch Pre-orders OPEN
notes.content:
[u][b]Message from the oneway Restoration Team: MERCH[/b][/u]
Preorders for our oneway.exe merch are now LIVE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789507/990e4e1432964ef078e9237a505836dbbdc836e0.jpg[/img]

Enjoy our demo? Support further development by placing an order with us TODAY! Stickers, shaker charms, keychains, and prints await YOU. 

Our preorder period ends November 30th 2024 @ 12 PM CST | GMT-6
Estimated shipping January 2025.
